edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
The whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerWithdraw runs.
The whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerDestroy runs.
ownerWithdraw reaches the owner.transfer external call only through the owner check.
ownerDestroy reaches selfdestruct only through the owner check.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor initialises round to 1.
Constructor pushes owner into participants[1].
userWithdraw reads withdrawals[msg.sender] controlled by the caller.
userWithdraw zeroes withdrawals[msg.sender] before transferring.
userWithdraw executes an external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
The transfer to msg.sender can invoke a fallback and re-enter the contract.
userRegister uses msg.sender as the registering participant.
userRegister pushes msg.sender into participants[round].
userRegister increments the round state variable on the odd branch.
userRegister credits withdrawals entries with the reward.
userRegister builds the random value from predictable blockhash data and caller input.
The random value feeds the modulo operation used for the payout branch.
The userRegister control flow branches on the result of random % 2.
The reward constant is credited to a withdrawal balance, accumulating unchecked sums.
The random seed includes participants[round][0], a publicly known address.
publicGetParticipants reads the length of the participants array.
publicGetParticipant reads participants[index][participant].
publicGetBalance reads the withdrawals mapping for the given player.
publicGetRound returns the round state variable.
The amount parameter is passed into the owner transfer call.
The amount local variable is read from the caller withdrawal balance.
The index parameter indexes the participants mapping.
The index parameter indexes the participants mapping.
The participant parameter indexes the inner participant array.
The player parameter indexes the withdrawals mapping.
The reward local variable is added into the withdrawals balance of a winner.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries data into ownerWithdraw and has no independent semantics.
The amount local variable is a temporary cache inside userWithdraw.
The index parameter is a pure input of publicGetParticipants.
The index parameter is a pure input of publicGetParticipant.
The participant parameter is a pure input of publicGetParticipant.
The player parameter is a pure input of publicGetBalance.
The reward local variable is defined and consumed only inside userRegister.
The random local variable is defined and consumed only inside userRegister.
